const validated = $('Validate Automatic Dispute').first().json
const gmail = $input.first().json
const messageId = typeof gmail.id === 'string' && gmail.id.trim() ? gmail.id.trim() : null
const receipt = {
  success: Boolean(messageId),
  deliveryStatus: messageId ? 'sent' : 'send_uncertain',
  idempotencyKey: validated.idempotencyKey,
  disputeId: validated.disputeId,
  recipient: validated.recipient,
  subject: validated.subject,
  messageId,
  threadId: typeof gmail.threadId === 'string' ? gmail.threadId : null,
  provider: 'gmail',
  sentAt: messageId ? new Date().toISOString() : null,
}
const staticData = $getWorkflowStaticData('global')
if (!staticData.sentReceipts || typeof staticData.sentReceipts !== 'object') staticData.sentReceipts = {}
staticData.sentReceipts[receipt.idempotencyKey] = receipt
return [{ json: receipt }]
